theme: Landed in Dubrovnik; the charter countdown begins.
greeting: You're in Dubrovnik, Dan, keys in hand to the apartment above the Old Port. Everything still open points at one deadline: the Sept 12 sailing charter needs sorting from dry land, while connectivity is good.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 20-Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: The p1 booking is due today: Full Size SUV out of TPA. No longer a hedge, since the Pathfinder can't reach Florida before Oct 18, so this cycle needs the rental. Don't land jet-lagged on a Sunday with no car.

needsAttention.title: Sort the Cavtat transfers
needsAttention.detail: Hotel Epidaurus is booked, but the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, an early bag hold, and the ~5:15 AM Sept 20 checkout all need arranging from land before you board, when signal drops to nothing.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding details
needsAttention.detail: Reach the sailing instructor to nail down Saturday Sept 12 boarding time and place, plus the return airport transfer after disembarking the 19th.

needsAttention.title: Close the Sept 20-22 St Pete nights
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sept 20 but the kids aren't picked up until the 22nd; two nights near St Pete are still unbooked before the Orlando villa.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and promos: Delta, Foreign Affairs, NYT Cooking, ANA, and a dozen retailers.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply; the Dubrovnik host already sent the address and welcome.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Early-autumn apples are at their crisp, honeyed peak — perfect for a slow-baked tart.

acts.line: Overnight from Tampa through Frankfurt, you touched down in Dubrovnik just after 11.
Keys to the Old Port apartment; the city is yours through Friday.
A quiet evening in Dubrovnik, with the Saturday charter the only thing on the horizon.
